canonical_project: 绵阳云计算中心 (Mianyang Cloud Computing Center)
notes: PR Newswire reported the first phase completed in 2013; jointly invested by Inspur and Mianyang government and operated by Inspur. Modular data center houses 1,000+ high-end servers/storage, provides processing capability equivalent to 5,000+ servers, 2,000 TB design storage and 300 trillion ops compute.
